label: Through-hole aspect ratio
subgoals: Divide board thickness by drilled diameter
Relate a high aspect ratio to thin barrel plating
Check every drill size against the stackup thickness

label: Minimum drill from a fab limit
section: Minimum drill from a fab limit
subgoals: Divide thickness by the maximum aspect ratio
Round up to the next available drill size
Distinguish drilled diameter from finished hole size

label: Microvia aspect ratio
subgoals: Take the spanned dielectric thickness as microvia depth
Multiply the drill diameter by the aspect cap to get the maximum depth
Flag build-up dielectrics that exceed the microvia limit
